units: world units; X east/west, Z north/south, Y elevation; widths/depths are FULL extents

bunker.name: Blacksite
bunker.description: A tight red-lit underground stronghold: interlocking rooms, a central vault and fast circular flanks.

shipyard.name: Breakwater
shipyard.description: An intimate waterfront brawl: open container court, short warehouse flanks and crane-overlook skirmishes.

compound.name: Verdant Ruins
compound.description: Sunlit jungle ruins: mossy stones, shaded courtyards, vegetation and several broken flank routes.

terminal.name: Afterlight City (Day)
terminal.description: The identical Afterlight neighborhood and spawns in natural daylight; day and night are lighting variants.

skybridge.name: Ridgefall
skybridge.description: Inside a sprawling steelworks: two foundry wings, a noisy assembly hall, overhead inspection gantries, loading bays and a maintenance annex. Dense machinery creates close-range angles below elevated industrial walkways.

arena_neon.name: Afterlight City
arena_neon.description: Nighttime streets in a glowing grid of shops, accessible rooftops and a central garden bandstand.

orbital_nexus.name: Orbital Nexus
orbital_nexus.description: An orbital research station over a violet gas giant: mirrored flag vaults, reactor crossfire, launch pads and three interconnected attack lanes.

floodgate.name: Floodgate
floodgate.description: 16v16 hydroelectric siege. Destroy the exposed dam core to rupture the spillway and permanently open the northern approach. Staggered turbine overlooks and maintenance decks break up the firing lanes.

whiteout_depot.name: Whiteout Depot
whiteout_depot.description: Snowbound freight depot with recurring whiteout fronts: clear-weather rail firefights turn into short-range ambushes across sheltered galleries when visibility collapses.
